description.message: Send selected links and downloads to Ratatoskr on this computer, without a cloud relay.

imagePickerSubtitle.message: Choose how you want to save this image.

imagePickerOriginalHint.message: Keeps the image unchanged and adds it to Ratatoskr.

imagePickerConvertedHint.message: The converted copy will be saved to your browser’s Downloads folder.

imagePickerExpired.message: This selection expired. Right-click the image and choose Download with Ratatoskr again.

popupImageSaved.message: Image saved to browser Downloads as $1

popupImageFailed.message: The image was not downloaded. Try again.

popupImagePermissionDenied.message: Permission to access this site was not granted.

popupImageTooLarge.message: This image is too large to convert safely. Try a smaller copy.

popupImageHttpFailed.message: The browser could not fetch this image. The site may require sign-in.

popupImageUnsupported.message: This image or output format is not supported by the browser.

popupImageDownloadFailed.message: The browser could not save the file to Downloads.

statusNoApp.message: Ratatoskr is not installed on this computer, or it was moved.

statusNoHost.message: Not connected yet. Open Ratatoskr once: it connects the browser by itself.

takeoverOff.message: Browser downloads stay in the browser

takeover.message: Send downloads from this browser to Ratatoskr

takeoverHint.message: When a download starts in the browser, Ratatoskr takes it over. If Ratatoskr cannot, the browser keeps it.

session.message: Hand over my browser login for downloads that need it

sessionHint.message: For that one download, the site's cookies go to Ratatoskr on this computer. They are kept in memory only, sent only to the same site, and forgotten when the download ends or the app closes. Turning this on asks the browser for permission to read cookies; turning it off gives it back.

minimumSize.message: Leave smaller files to the browser (MB)

excludedHosts.message: Sites the browser keeps (one per line)

excludedExtensions.message: File types the browser keeps (for example: pdf, jpg)

altSkip.message: Alt+click leaves a download to the browser

altSkipHint.message: Hold Alt while clicking a link and the browser downloads it itself. This needs a small script on every site, so the browser asks for access to all sites.
